display_long_description:
Launch the ball, fire the flippers, and dive into the ultimate VR pinball arcade — welcome to Pinball Universe VR! This isn't just one table. It's a whole universe of pinball waiting to be explored.

Step up to four original pinball tables, each a fully themed world with its own missions, artwork, and atmosphere:

🐉 Dragon's Treasure Cave — raid a fiery hoard guarded by a mighty dragon

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — battle through deep space and mech warfare

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebrate a vibrant Día de los Muertos night

🐙 Octopus Island — dive into a bright tropical ocean adventure

Feel authentic pinball physics, responsive flippers, dynamic lighting, and immersive sound that bring every table to life in VR.

Play, earn, and collect. Complete repeatable table missions and rack up high scores to earn in-game cash. Spend it on trophies, collectibles, and prizes to personalize your arcade and show off your skill.

More than pinball. Take a break with fun arcade games like darts and basketball, grab a drink, and hang out in your own retro arcade — then get right back to the tables.

A growing universe. New pinball tables and games are always on the way, so there's always more to master.

Whether you're chasing the perfect ball, hunting a new high score, or building your dream arcade, Pinball Universe VR delivers deep, skill-based pinball wrapped in a colorful world you'll want to return to again and again.
Grab a machine, pull the plunger, and start your pinball adventure today!
